surface.doc: The one surface: every window, sheet and screen sits on it.

raised.doc: Things that float over the surface for a moment: popovers, menus, bubbles and small panels.

raisedHigh.doc: A row or header on a floating thing, one step lighter.

doorway.doc: An open hole in the floor an Imp hides in.

ink.doc: Dark ink on any background, for text on a bright fill.

paper.doc: Light paper on any background, for text over a picture, a scrim or a dark fill.

faint.doc: The quietest text and idle icons.

card.doc: A pebble: the soft fill that groups things on the surface. It has no outline.

line.doc: A thin line, for tracks and drawings only. Groups and rows are never outlined or divided with it.

well.doc: A well for text fields, editors and code.

accent.doc: The accent when no Imp gives its colour. The chrome is monochrome, the colour belongs to the Imps.

accentBright.doc: The accent at its brightest, for a spark or a highlight.

onAccent.doc: Text and icons on the accent.

heart.doc: A little heart that floats up with the embers.

warnBackground.doc: A notice that needs a look.

danger.doc: Text and icons of a destructive action or a failure.

okEdge.doc: The line around a success message.

focus.doc: The keyboard focus ring when no Imp gives its colour.

scrim.doc: A dark veil behind small labels over the wall.

veil.doc: Over a picture or tile background behind settings, so the surface stays calm.

sparkEmber.doc: An ordinary spark of the phone's game: warm orange.

sparkWisp.doc: A cool wisp of smoke or a storm spark.

sparkHot.doc: A hot spark in the games.

sparkSmokeEdge.doc: The edge of a smoke puff in the games.

sparkSmokeCore.doc: The dark core of a smoke puff in the games.

sparkGoldCore.doc: The white-hot core of a golden spark.

sparkChain.doc: A pink spark of a ring.

sparkChainCore.doc: The core of a ring spark.

sparkKindleCore.doc: The core of a green kindling spark.

echoAccent.doc: The violet of the Echo game.

hairline.doc: Between a line and its own detail.

tight.doc: Inside a control: an icon and its word.

snug.doc: Between small things in a row.

cozy.doc: Inside a small tile or a chip.

wide.doc: Around a sheet or a big empty state.

huge.doc: Between actions that must stay apart.

tiny.doc: Thumbnails and small marks inside a row.

small.doc: Fields, small tiles and chips that are not capsules.

tile.doc: Icon tiles and small cards inside a card.

medium.doc: Cards on the desktop, selectable cards and wells.

large.doc: Cards on the phone and big panels.

focus.doc: The keyboard focus ring and a chosen tile's edge.

disabled.doc: A control that cannot be used now.

dimmed.doc: Something left out or not chosen.

tintFill.doc: A soft fill in the Imp's colour, behind an icon or a chosen row.

tintFillStrong.doc: A stronger fill in the Imp's colour: a secondary button on the dark wall.

glow.doc: The glow under a chosen Imp.

hoverFill.doc: A solid fill under the pointer.

bubbleMin.doc: The least opaque a translucent speech bubble may be. Below this the text cannot be kept legible over any background.

bubbleDefault.doc: How opaque a translucent speech bubble starts.

receiptLift.doc: How far a short receipt bar sits above the bottom edge, clear of the hidden Imps' floor and the home indicator.

hit.doc: The smallest a control's hit area gets.

control.doc: The height of a text field or a menu button.

glyph.doc: The visible circle of an icon button.

iconTile.doc: The tile behind a card's or a row's icon.

menuWidth.doc: The width of the menu bar panel.

toastTop.doc: Where a notice in a sheet hangs from the top: below the header, clear of the sheet's grabber.

sheetIcon.doc: The icon tile in a sheet's header.

tipWidth.doc: The widest a help tip's text runs.

popoverWidth.doc: The width of a popover that holds a list or a small form.

popupWidth.doc: The fixed width of a browser toolbar popup. Wide enough for a pebble and a button, narrow enough to stay a popup.

popupListHeight.doc: The tallest a scrolling list grows inside a small popup before it scrolls.

panelWidth.doc: A side panel beside the Imp on a wide screen.

column.doc: The widest a settings column grows. Wider screens centre it.

sheetWidth.doc: The width of a sheet on a desktop.

marker.doc: A setting's round marker around the Imp.

impPortrait.doc: The Imp drawn in a row or a card.

fieldLabel.doc: The label column of a form row, so a card's controls line up.

mark.doc: A round tick or a status mark.

menuTitle.doc: The widest a menu button's title runs before it ends in an ellipsis, so a long name never widens a form.

heroFace.doc: An Imp's face on the kit review's header.

dot.doc: A status dot or a small marker beside a title.

editorWidth.doc: The animation editor's sheet: the stage, the beat's pose and the timeline side by side.

stageWidth.doc: The animation editor's stage, where the Imp acts a beat out.

editorTop.doc: The height of the animation editor's stage and pose row, above the timeline.

switchTrack.doc: The width of a switch's track.

codeSide.doc: The side of the linking QR code.

viewfinderHeight.doc: The height of the camera view that scans a code.

viewfinderAim.doc: The side of the frame to aim a code at.

heroImp.doc: The sleeping Imp on the first-run sheet.

gameButton.doc: The round button that starts a game.

coachBadge.doc: The icon place on a game rules card.

gameIcon.doc: The icon column of a game message.

echoPad.doc: The touch pad of the Echo game.

gameCard.doc: The widest a game's results or rules card runs.

gameStat.doc: The narrowest column of a results stat, before the stats stack.

meter.doc: The bar that counts a special phase down.

doorLabel.doc: The widest a door label runs.

bubbleHeader.doc: The widest a speech bubble header runs.

thumbHeight.doc: The tallest a picture in a speech bubble gets.

thumbWaitWidth.doc: The place held for a picture still loading.

thumbWaitHeight.doc: The place held for a picture still loading, its height.

hiddenStrip.doc: The strip along the bottom edge where a hiding Imp peeks.

label.doc: The label of a button or a chip.

caption.doc: A form label and other quiet lines.

display.doc: The one big number of a screen, such as a game's score.

tiny.doc: A chevron inside a menu button.

small.doc: A status dot or a mark beside small text.

medium.doc: An icon beside a label, in a chip or a tile.

large.doc: An icon button's glyph and a card's icon.

big.doc: A marker or a sheet's icon.

short.doc: Hover, press, focus and other small changes.

medium.doc: Sliding, appearing and other changes you follow with your eyes.

reducedFade.doc: With Reduce Motion, a preset marked fade changes opacity over this long and does not move.

quick.doc: Hover, focus, switches and small changes.

expand.doc: A section opening or closing, a list changing.

smooth.doc: Selections, tabs and other changes you follow with your eyes.

scene.doc: One scene giving way to another.

settle.doc: Bubbles and bars finding their place.

pop.doc: A small reward: a little overshoot.

fade.doc: Something coming or going with no movement.

peek.doc: A hidden Imp sliding out from the floor and back.

toastSeconds.doc: How long a short message at the bottom of the screen stays.

noticeSeconds.doc: How long a floating notice (a failure's details) stays before it goes away by itself.

undoBarSeconds.doc: How long the Undo bar stays after an Imp is let out, sent home or sent to another device.

peekIntervalMinSeconds.doc: The shortest wait before a hidden Imp peeks out.

peekIntervalMaxSeconds.doc: The longest wait before a hidden Imp peeks out.

peekShowSeconds.doc: How long a peeking Imp stays visible.

peekQuietSeconds.doc: A peek waits until the user has not typed for this long.

narrowWindowPoints.doc: Below this width Imp Settings shows its plain list under the Imp.

dragStripPoints.doc: The height of the strip along the top of a desktop window that drags the window.

localProbeTimeoutSeconds.doc: How long the first run waits for one local model server to answer before it moves to the next.

brainCheckTimeoutSeconds.doc: How long the first run waits for a Brain to answer its first small request.

copiedTickSeconds.doc: How long a Copy button shows its tick after it copied.

tiltSlide.doc: How far an Imp is pulled sideways by a full tilt, in points. It springs back when the phone is level. The first screen and the home screen use it.

tiltLean.doc: How far an Imp leans into a full tilt, in degrees. The first screen and the home screen use it.

framesPerSecond.doc: Frames a second for anything that visibly moves: a head turning, eyes following the cursor or the tilt, a hop, a mood fading.

framesPerSecondSaving.doc: The same, in Low Power Mode or when the device runs warm.

calmFramesPerSecond.doc: Frames a second for an Imp that only breathes, blinks and floats. Nothing changing means no frames at all.

calmFramesPerSecondSaving.doc: The same, in Low Power Mode or when the device runs warm.

sensorHz.doc: Motion-sensor readings a second while an Imp follows the tilt. Each frame eases towards the last reading.

sensorHzSaving.doc: The same, in Low Power Mode.

settleSeconds.doc: How long frames stay at the moving rate after the last movement, so a head turning back or a mood fading is drawn to its end.

summonStiffness.doc: The spring that brings an Imp up into the free room when its sheet opens: how hard it pulls.

summonDamping.doc: The spring that brings an Imp up into the free room when its sheet opens: how fast it calms. A little under critical, so the Imp arrives with a small overshoot.

summonHeight.doc: How far down the free room above a sheet the Imp waits (0 top, 1 bottom), so its speech bubble has room above it.

sheetHalfCover.doc: The share of the screen a sheet resting at half height covers.
